<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1355
Claimant:
Leah Bowen
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2025-04-26
Reported a sideswipe while changing lanes, with the claimant's vehicle struck on the driver's side. The claimant has
retained counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2025-04-28
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle in the lane change and lists the claimant as present in
the car at the scene.
2025-06-02
Two independent witnesses gave statements that match the claimant's description of the collision, and the other
driver confirmed the same sequence of events.
2025-06-15
Reviewed scene photos and the estimate. The damage to the side panels and mirror lines up with the impact
described by everyone involved, and no older damage is visible in the file.
2025-06-29
Checked the policy history. The coverage was in force well before the loss, and nothing in the records suggests the
vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
2025-07-03
The claimant's recorded statement through counsel describes the same sequence as the first contact. The account
has not changed in any conversation so far.
2025-08-22
The initial medical report documents neck and back strain, which fits the force and direction of a side impact of this
type. No prior treatment to the same areas appears in the records requested.
2025-08-28
Treatment began promptly after the accident. Visits have since increased and new services have been added month
after month, well beyond what is typical for a strain injury of this kind.
2025-08-30
Asked the treating provider for an updated plan of care and the rationale for the added services. Response from
counsel's office is pending.
2025-09-27
The driver of the veihcle lives in the policyholder's household and qualifies as a covered household member under
the policy. Coverage for the driver's involvement is confirmed.
2025-09-28
Sent the medical bills and records to the medical review unit for an evaluation of treatment frequency and the
services billed against the documented injury.
2025-10-09
Claim remains open. The liability picture is clear and the vehicle damage is consistent with the accident. Next step is
the medical review, and counsel will be updated once it is complete.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
